name: system
title: System
description: System commands from the keyboard: sleep, lock, restart, shut down, empty the trash, dark mode, volume, brightness, eject, quit every app, clear notifications. Keep the computer awake for a while, until a time or while an app runs, with a countdown on the bar.
author: pal

settings.label: Ask first
settings.text: Confirm before logging out, restarting, shutting down, emptying the trash or quitting every app
settings.description: Log Out, Restart, Shut Down, Empty Trash and Quit All Apps show a confirmation first; off runs them at once.

settings.label: Keep awake for
settings.description: What a bare Keep Awake runs for: 45m, 2h, 1h30m, a clock time like 14:30, or forever.

settings.label: Display
settings.description: On: neither the machine nor the display sleeps (caffeinate -d -i). Off: the display may sleep while the machine stays up, for a download or a build. The row's Display field and the popover's switch override it per run.

store.tagline: Sleep, lock, restart, dark mode, volume, keep awake
features: Type `mute`, `sleep` or `power off` at the root to find the command
Only what this machine can do is listed; Empty Trash shows how much is in it, Dark Mode the current look
Keep Awake for `45m`, `2h`, until `14:30` or while an app runs; the bar counts down, and it ends on time even if pal quits
Quit All Apps asks each app the usual way, so unsaved work still prompts; Unhide All Apps and Dismiss Notifications too
Log Out, Restart, Shut Down and Empty Trash ask first (a setting)
Quick Look on what is selected in Finder (macOS)

screenshots.caption: The commands this machine can run; the appearance and the Trash count on the right
caffeinate at the root finds Keep Awake: the rows are indexed with their keywords
Quit All Apps (asks first), Unhide All Apps, Dismiss Notifications, and Quick Look on what is marked in Finder
On the menu bar: a coffee and what is left of the run
The display kept awake too: a monitor mark after the countdown
A click opens the popover: the run on a card with the time left and a bar, the presets on the digits, the display switch, Enter allows sleep
Until turned off: ∞ on the strip and the card; a preset gives it an end
u opens the field: 45m, 14:30 or forever, then Enter
On sketchybar: the coffee and the countdown as the label

actions.title: Run
actions.description: The command; Log Out, Restart, Shut Down, Empty Trash and Quit All Apps ask first.

actions.title: Keep awake
actions.description: On Keep Awake: for what the bar's field says, else the default; cmd+enter until turned off; cmd+u the form (a time, an app to follow, the display).

actions.title: Allow sleep
actions.description: On the row while a run is on; cmd+d flips whether the display is kept awake too.

id.description: sleep, lock, logout, restart, shutdown, empty-trash, dark-mode, volume-up, volume-down, volume-mute, brightness-up, brightness-down, dnd, eject-all, show-desktop, keep-awake (the toggle: the default duration, or off), quit-all, unhide-all, dismiss-notifications, quick-look-selection (macOS)

awake.description: Keep the machine awake, or let it sleep

for.description: How long: 45m, 2h, 1h30m, or a clock time like 14:30, or forever; blank with nothing else toggles (the default duration, or off while on)

until.description: The same as for; a clock time reads best here (tomorrow's when today's has passed)

display.description: Keep the display awake too (the setting otherwise)

app.description: An app with a window open: the run ends when it quits (caffeinate -w)

system.title: System
system.description: What this machine can do from here; Keep Awake takes how long in the bar.

keys.title: Run the command; on Keep Awake, for what the bar says (the default when blank); Allow Sleep while a run is on
On Keep Awake: until turned off
On Keep Awake: a form for a time, an app to follow and the display
On Allow Sleep: keep the display awake too, or let it sleep

awake_until.description: When the run ends, unix ms; null without an end

awake_left.description: Minutes left, rounded up; null without an end

awake_display.description: The display is kept awake too

awake.title: Keep Awake
awake.description: A coffee glyph and what is left of the run (∞ without an end), a monitor mark when the display is kept awake too; hidden while off (`show = "always"` keeps a muted coffee). The popover: the run on a card with the time left and a bar, the presets as tiles on the digits, the display switch, Allow sleep on Enter; `u` opens a field for a time or a duration.

item.tooltip: Awake until 16:29, 1 h 59 min left, display too

Keep the display awake too, or let it sleep

settings.label: Presets
settings.description: The durations on the popover's tiles and its digit keys, five at most: durations, clock times, or forever.
